ios.desc:
Pitch your next unicorn to Steve Jobs, spar politics with Cleopatra, or craft a killer whodunit with Agatha Christie—all in one app.

Dinner Party makes the impossible possible. Chat with over a thousand real, contemporary, and fictional personas using state of the art AI.

HIGHLIGHTS
• 1,000+ Characters & Counting
Historical leaders, modern innovators, literary legends, anime heroes—you choose.

• Real-Time, Context-Aware Chat
Powered by the latest GPT models for fluid, in-character replies that remember the thread.

• Curated Bios & Knowledge Packs
Every persona is seeded with verified facts, timelines, and signature quotes for accurate answers.

• Categories, Search & “Random Guest”
Browse by era, genre, or field—or spin the wheel for a surprise visitor at your virtual table.

DISCLAIMER
AI content may contain errors or bias, this app is purely for entertainment purposes.

Download Dinner Party now and host the greatest conversation of every era, genre, and universe—right in your pocket.
